title: CLIBENCH: A Multifaceted and Multigranular Evaluation of Large Language Models for Clinical Decision Making

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing average F1 scores of the models' diagnostic predictions between male and female patient records.
Comparing average F1 scores of the models' diagnostic predictions across different patient racial and ethnic groups (e.g., Asian, Black/African American, Hispanic/Latino, White, Other Race, Unknown).
Comparing average F1 scores of the models' diagnostic predictions across different patient insurance types (e.g., Medicaid, Medicare, Other Insurance).
